map.由功率、时长与电价求电费 使用指南: Electricity Cost from Power, Duration and Tariff - User Guide
map.输入设备功率（瓦）、使用时长（小时）与电价（元/度），工具先换算为千瓦再计算应付: Enter device power (W), usage time (hours) and tariff (yuan/kWh); the tool first converts to kW then computes the electricity cost, suitable for estimating daily appliance cost.
map.输入功率 P（瓦）、用电时长 h（小时）与电价，求电费。: Enter power P (W), duration h (hours) and tariff to find electricity cost.
map.估算月度电费与阶梯影响。: Estimate monthly electricity cost and tiered-rate impact.
: Daily use 30 kWh, of which 20 kWh shifted to valley (0.3 yuan) replacing peak (0.9 yuan): original 30 x 0.58 = 17.4 yuan, optimized 10 x 0.9 + 20 x 0.3 = 15 yuan, daily saving 2.4 yuan, yearly about 876 yuan. Note: storage/smart scheduling amplifies the benefit.
map.阶梯电价怎么算？: How is tiered electricity pricing calculated?
map.按累计用量分段计价，增量部分适用更高单价，因此高用量月费用非线性上升。: Tiered pricing by cumulative usage; the incremental part uses a higher unit price, so high-usage months rise non-linearly.
map.可转移负荷（储能、热水、充电桩）用户受益大；刚性实时负荷受益有限。: Shiftable loads (storage, water heating, EV charging) benefit users most; rigid real-time loads benefit little.
